title: What the Machine Invented: Mining New Mathematical Instruments from OpenAI's October 2026 Release of AI-Generated Mathematics
abstract: arXiv:2610.17090v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On 6 October 2026 OpenAI published an initial 722 AI-written mathematical manuscripts, organized into 372 problem families, in the public repository github.com/openai/math. The release includes claimed solutions to many prominent open problems. We approach this collection as a treasure mine of mathematical ideas. Our aim is to extract new lemmas, constructions, inequalities and proof mechanisms introduced in the source arguments, and to distinguish them from established tools and new combinations of those tools. We call these mathematical instruments. Extraction comes first; their validity, novelty and possible reuse then become subjects for further study. The resulting descriptions also help readers understand the selected papers without having to reconstruct every argument at the outset.   We examine 38 families in two groups of 17 and 21, spanning number theory, geometry, analysis, combinatorics, complexity, algebra, operator algebr

translated_title: 机器发明了什么：从OpenAI 2026年10月发布的AI生成数学中挖掘新数学工具
translated_abstract: 2026年10月6日，OpenAI在公开仓库github.com/openai/math中发布了首批722篇由AI撰写的数学手稿，整理为372个问题族。该发布包含对许多著名未解决问题的声称解答。我们将这一合集视为数学思想的宝库。我们的目标是提取源论证中引入的新引理、构造、不等式和证明机制，并将它们与已有工具及这些工具的新组合区分开来。我们将这些称为“数学工具”。提取是首要任务；其有效性、新颖性以及可能的复用则成为后续研究的课题。由此产生的描述也帮助读者无需一开始就重构每个论证即可理解所选论文。我们分两组（17个和21个）考察了38个问题族，涵盖数论、几何、分析、组合数学、复杂性理论、代数、算子代数等领域。
tldr: 本文将OpenAI于2026年10月发布的722篇AI生成数学手稿视为思想宝库，系统提取并区分了其中的新引理、构造、不等式和证明机制等“数学工具”，考察了38个问题族。
en_tdlr: This paper treats OpenAI's October 2026 release of 722 AI-generated mathematics manuscripts as a treasure mine, systematically extracting and distinguishing new mathematical instruments—lemmas, constructions, inequalities, and proof mechanisms—across 38 problem families.
